assumptions: The coordinator stack exists, its API advertisement gate may remain false, and no build command is sent.
The Auto Scaling group has minimum and desired capacity zero, so it has no EC2, EBS, or public IPv4 charge while idle.
Three directly called interface endpoints (SQS, RDS Data API, and CloudWatch Logs) remain provisioned in one dev availability zone; the S3 gateway endpoint has no hourly charge.
Secrets Manager and KMS authorization remain exact IAM conditions but do not need client endpoints because Data API and S3 perform those calls service-side.
The queue and dead-letter queue contain no messages and use SQS-managed encryption.
One coordinator database secret and two standard CloudWatch alarms remain allocated.
Requests, endpoint data, host runtime, EBS while running, S3, Data API, KMS API calls, logs, and database wake time are usage-dependent and excluded at zero commands.

items.description: Three continuously provisioned single-AZ interface endpoint ENIs
t4g.large trusted hosts at desired capacity zero
